routes.name: Visa Exemption (short stay)
routes.summary: Many nationalities can enter for up to 15 days without a visa, extendable to 90 days if immigration conditions are met. Some countries have longer bilateral deals.

other: Bilateral deals: Angola, Mozambique, Guinea-Bissau, Ghana, Gabon, Rwanda and South Africa up to 90 days. Cape Verde 60 to 120 days per year. Togo up to 90 days, check implementation.
Other nationalities may qualify with a passport valid over 3 months plus a valid Schengen or US visa.
The page gives no effective date. Confirm with SMF.

stay.note: Extendable to 90 days if requirements are met.

routes.name: e-VisaST (entry authorization)
routes.summary: Apply online with SMF for an entry visa. You get an answer within 7 business days. Payment is made at the border.

other: Passport valid 3 months past your stay.
Proof of means at the border: 100 EUR per day.
Fee amount not stated on the page.

documents: Minors: birth certificate and guardian declaration
Transit: proof of entry to the destination country
routes.processing: Response within 7 business days, per the SMF page.

routes.name: Temporary Visa
routes.summary: Valid up to 180 days, one or more entries, continuous stay up to 3 months. Must be used within 90 days of issue. No paid work except cultural activity.

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: One entry, or exceptionally two. Each transit lasts up to 4 days. You must be able to continue to a country that will admit you.

routes.name: Residence for Employed Work
routes.summary: Needs a job contract with a favorable opinion from the labor ministry. Residence certificates are valid 1 year and renewable.

other: Nationals and legal residents get hiring preference. Pay may not be lower than a national's.

routes.name: Residence for Independent Work and Investment
routes.summary: For self-employed people and investors. Visa needs an investment operation or proof of enough funds to start an activity. Certificate needs a registered company or declared start of activity.

other: No investment minimum is set in the law text read.

routes.name: Residence for Research and Highly Qualified Work
routes.summary: Researchers need a link to a recognized research center. Highly qualified workers need a compatible job offer.

routes.name: Student Residence
routes.summary: Needs proof of enrollment and means of subsistence. Valid 1 year and renewable. Students may work outside program periods with prior authorization.

eligibility.education: Admission to a higher education institution for university study

routes.name: Family Reunification
routes.summary: The sponsor needs a valid residence certificate for at least 1 year, adequate housing and means. Covers spouse, minor or dependent children, dependent parents and stable partners.

other: Sponsor holds residence for at least 1 year.
Adequate housing and means of subsistence.
The SMF Director makes the decision.

routes.name: Permanent Residence Certificate
routes.summary: After 5 consecutive years on a temporary certificate, with a clean record and Portuguese knowledge. Renewed every 5 years.

other: No prison sentence over 1 year in the last 5 years.
